identity.name: AutoMapGuard
identity.theme_strategy: Dark Mode First (Professional GIS Standard). Light mode available for reporting.

usage_rules: Data values, coordinates, and IDs must use 'JetBrains Mono'.
Body text uses 'Inter' for maximum legibility at small sizes.
Use uppercase + wide tracking (tracking-widest) for labels (e.g., 'LATITUDE', 'CONFIDENCE').

structure.dashboard: Grid layout: Sidebar (fixed) + Main Content (scrollable). Main content uses a 4-column grid.
structure.map_view: Full-screen map canvas (z-0) with floating HUD panels (z-10).
structure.panels: Floating panels must use glassmorphism: bg-zinc-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10.

cards.style: Flat, border-only or subtle background. No heavy drop shadows.

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-sm font-mono text-sm

badges.style: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium font-mono uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-none or shadow-sm for depth. Use 'glow' effects for active states.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to reduce banding.

animations.scan: Custom scanline animation for processing states

libraries.maps: react-map-gl (Mapbox wrapper) or Leaflet (react-leaflet) if API key constrained.
libraries.tables: TanStack Table (via Shadcn Data Table) for the review queue.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. Use APCA for dark mode validation.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, only for subtle borders or active states.
Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and density.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Map View' as the core experience. The dashboard should feel like a cockpit. Use the provided satellite images as placeholders for the map layers if a real map tile service is not configured. Prioritize the 'Review Queue' and 'Change Inspector' panels as floating elements over the map.
